notes: The verse writes three *that*s and each answers to a different morpheme: the frame's on הָיָה, since the apodosis opens with no waw of its own (rule 45); the relative אֲשֶׁר's; and the purpose connective the waw of וְלֹא־יִמָּחֶה carries (rules 14, 55).
*first born* is headed on *born*; heading on *first* was the competing reading (rule 31).
